title: Child Safe Standards and Reportable Conduct guidance moving to the SSR website
body: From 1 October 2026, guidance and resources on the Child Safe Standards and Reportable Conduct Scheme will move from the Commission for Children and Young People website to the Social Services Regulator website. Legal obligations will not change, but clubs should review links to Commission information in their websites, policies and other materials and update them where required. Clubs should continue to contact the SSR about both schemes.
verifiedQuote: From 1 October 2026, information, including guidance and resources, about the Child Safe Standards and Reportable Conduct Scheme will move from the Commission for Children and Young People website to the Social Services Regulator (SSR) website.
correction: The draft states guidance 'moved' (past tense) but the source clearly states it 'will move' (future tense) from 1 October 2026, and the draft incorrectly says 'keep contacting' when the source says 'continue to contact'.

title: Unfinished WWC Check applications may be deleted from 19 October
body: Anyone who starts an online Working with Children Check application but doesn't complete it, including verifying their identity, before Monday 19 October 2026 may have their application deleted. They will then need to start a new application and complete the mandatory child safety training.
verifiedQuote: If you start an online application but don't complete it before Monday 19 October 2026, including verifying your identity, your application may be deleted. You will then need to start a new application and complete the mandatory child safety training.
correction: The draft incorrectly stated applications 'may be deleted' and incorrectly referred to 'coaches and volunteers' and 'clubs' when the source doesn't mention sport specifically, but the core claim about incomplete applications is supported.
